objective:
Build the History screen: every logged or pending capture, newest first, with filter chips, empty states, and resolving Needs-review / Not-categorized captures from their rows.

BACKGROUND (read the code; reuse, do not duplicate):
- `ActivityRepository.loadHistory(): List<HistoryEntry>` (core-domain RepositoryTypes.kt) returns captures that have an ACTIVE occurrence or no occurrence, newest first; `HistoryEntry.occurrence` is null for uncategorized captures, `processingState` tells NEEDS_REVIEW apart, `pendingMatchedActivityId` is the latest interpretation's match.
- The Log screen (UI1.3) in app-phone `ui.log` already has: `LogViewModel` (with a private `suggestionsFor(captureId, rawText)` -- pending matched activity if still in the catalog, then `CandidateSelector` order, de-duplicated, max 3), a guarded `runAction` pattern for writes (catches storage failures, ignores a second tap while one is in flight), the Recent row composable in `LogScreen.kt` with merged one-sentence semantics, result cards in `ResultCards.kt`, refusal-message mapping in `RefusalMessages.kt`, and `LogViewModelFactory` built from `ActivityLedgerApplication`. Shared UI: `ui.components.ActivityPicker` (bottom sheet; `(activities, onChoose: (ActivityTarget) -> Unit, onDismiss, startWithNewActivity)`), `StateTag`, `EvidenceText`, `ui.time.OccurrenceTimeFormatter`, `ui.theme`.
- Test fixtures: `app-phone/src/test/.../ui/log/LogTestFixtures.kt` (RecordingRepository with failure injection) and core-testing's `InMemoryActivityRepository`, `FakeActivityInterpreter`, `MutableClock`.
- Specs: docs/UX_VISUAL_SPEC.md 3 D1 (History tab), D7 (review without an inbox: filter chips All / Needs review / Not categorized; no badges, no counts, no 'clear all'), 4.2 (rows), 4.3 (time), 5 (accessibility), 6 (copy); docs/UX_SPEC.md 6 (history), 13 (empty states), 15 (exclusions).

DO:
1. Refactor for reuse (behaviour-preserving; all existing Log tests must still pass unchanged or with only import/package updates):
   - Move the history row composable (and its row UI model + `HistoryEntry` -> row mapping) out of `LogScreen.kt`/`LogViewModel.kt` into `ui.components` (e.g. `HistoryRow.kt`) so Log's Recent and the History screen render identical rows.
   - Move suggestion building out of LogViewModel into a small shared, pure-Kotlin helper in a new package `ui.review` (e.g. `ReviewSuggestions.suggest(repository, captureId, rawText)`), same rules; LogViewModel calls it. Move the ServiceRefusal -> message mapping to `ui.review` too if History needs it (it does).
2. `ui.history.HistoryViewModel` (constructor-injected like LogViewModel; hand-written factory from ActivityLedgerApplication): state = selected filter (ALL default / NEEDS_REVIEW / NOT_CATEGORIZED), rows, loaded flag, the capture currently being resolved (with its suggestions) or null, picker state, actionInFlight, message. Loads on start and after every write. Filters: NEEDS_REVIEW = no occurrence and processingState NEEDS_REVIEW; NOT_CATEGORIZED = no occurrence and any other state; ALL = everything loadHistory returns. Same guarded-write pattern as LogViewModel (storage failures -> plain-words message, second tap ignored). No undo window here (D5: Remove from history lives in the occurrence sheet, which is out of scope).
3. Resolving from History: tapping a Needs-review or Not-categorized row opens a resolution bottom sheet showing the words (EvidenceText), 'Your words are saved. Nothing was guessed.' (Needs review only), 'Which activity was this?' with up to 3 suggestion buttons, 'Choose another activity' (opens ActivityPicker), 'Create new activity' (ActivityPicker in new-activity mode), and 'Decide later' (closes). Choosing calls `ReviewResolutionService.resolve`; Resolved -> sheet closes, list reloads (the row becomes an interpreted row); Refused -> message in the sheet. Tapping an interpreted row does nothing yet (the occurrence sheet is a later slice) -- do not make it look clickable.
4. `ui.history.HistoryScreen` replacing the placeholder: title 'History', M3 FilterChips 'All' / 'Needs review' / 'Not categorized' (single-select, no counts), a LazyColumn of shared rows, newest first. Empty states: nothing logged at all -> 'No activities logged yet. Type what you just did.' (same string as Log's empty Recent -- reuse it); a filter with no matches -> 'Nothing needs review.' / 'Nothing is waiting to be categorized.' (new copy, calm, no 'all caught up' / goal language per UX_SPEC 15). History is reached from the NavigationBar and from Log's 'All history' (already wired).
5. Accessibility: chips have selected state semantics; tappable rows are announced as buttons with an action label ('Choose an activity'); rows keep the merged one-sentence description; 48dp targets.
6. Strings in strings.xml only.
7. Tests: HistoryViewModelTest (in-memory repository + real services + MutableClock + test dispatcher): ordering preserved from loadHistory; each filter's contents (mix of interpreted, NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, CAPTURED); hidden occurrences absent; opening a row computes suggestions (pending first, de-dup, max 3); resolve to existing and to new -> row becomes interpreted and leaves the Needs-review filter; refused resolve (e.g. new name matching an existing activity) shows a message and keeps the sheet; storage failure on resolve and on load shows a message without crashing; second resolve while in flight ignored; decide later closes without writing. A Robolectric HistoryScreen test: empty state text; chips switch the list; tapping a Needs-review row opens the sheet with 'Decide later'. Existing Log and navigation tests must still pass. Update `MainActivityNavigationTest` only if the History title text it asserts changed.

PRIVACY (AGENTS.md #11): no logging; no raw text in exception messages; no new permission.

DEVICE SAFETY: no device needed. Never run adb, installDebug or any connected* task. Set ANDROID_SERIAL=none-for-this-task in the environment of every Gradle command.
non_goals: No occurrence sheet, Remove from history, Edit interpretation, Activity detail, Ask or Settings.
No search in History, no counts or badges, no 'clear all'.
No change to Log behaviour beyond the behaviour-preserving extraction in step 1.
No change to core-* modules, CapturePipeline, app-wear, build files or the version catalog.

acceptance_criteria: History row rendering, the HistoryEntry->row mapping, suggestion building and refusal messages are shared between Log and History (no duplicated logic); Log behaviour unchanged and its tests pass.
HistoryScreen shows loadHistory() rows newest first with single-select filter chips All / Needs review / Not categorized (filters as specified), no counts or badges, and the specified empty states.

Tapping a Needs-review or Not-categorized row opens a resolution sheet (words, suggestions max 3, Choose another activity, Create new activity, Decide later) that resolves only via ReviewResolutionService; interpreted rows are not clickable.

Accessibility per UX_VISUAL_SPEC 5 (chip selected state, row button semantics with action label, merged one-sentence rows, 48dp targets); all copy in strings.xml.
HistoryViewModelTest and the Robolectric HistoryScreen test cover the behaviours in step 7 and pass; `:app-phone:assembleDebug :app-phone:testDebugUnitTest` green.
